resources.string: Seeing \"App was denied access\"? Tap App info, then ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings, then come back and tap Grant again.
Important: Android will block this at first

Because this app isn't from the Play Store, Android will say "App was denied access" when you switch it on. That's normal.

To unlock it (one time only):

1. Tap Continue, tap Political Text Blocker, and tap OK on the "denied access" message.
2. Come back and tap App info.
3. Tap ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings, and confirm.
4. Come back and tap Grant again. It works this time.
